about.heading: Meet Max
about.body:
Pirate Barber is Max: one barber, one chair, and no front desk to get past. He cuts in Cove, at the north end of Cache Valley, and people come up the valley for it.

Call or text and you get a time straight from the person doing the cutting. Not sure what you're after? Say so. That is what the first five minutes are for.

items.quote: Max always leaves me looking fresh. Great barber. Great experience.
items.name: Caden Sorenson

items.a: Cove, Utah, at the north end of Cache Valley up US-91 past Richmond. Clients come in from Logan, Smithfield, Hyde Park, Richmond, and Lewiston. Call or text for the exact address when you book.
Yes. It is one barber and one chair, so call or text (435) 764-5900 to grab a time. Appointments outside the listed hours are usually doable if you ask.
A haircut is $35 and includes the consultation, shampoo, and styling. A shave is $20, and kids 12 and under are $20.
Not yet. Calling or texting (435) 764-5900 goes straight to Max, which is faster than any booking app anyway.
Tuesday and Wednesday 10am to 5pm, Thursday through Saturday 10am to 7pm, closed Sunday and Monday. Appointments outside those hours can usually be arranged.

contact.heading: Book a cut
contact.intro: There is no booking app. Call or text Max and you will have a time in a minute.
